lines.note: 加卢日记旁白的通行译法；片中重复「Maybe freedom begins with remorse. I heard that somewhere.」。

lines.text: 我不知道这一切会如何收场。我想我会等着。等什么？我不知道。
lines.en: I don't know how it will end. I think I'll wait. Wait for what? I don't know.
